app.description: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

guardrail_id.description:
The ID to use for the guardrail, which will become the final component of
the guardrail's resource name. If not provided, a unique ID will be
automatically assigned for the guardrail.

location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

action.description: Action that is taken when a certain precondition is met.

action.generative_answer.description: The agent will immediately respond with a generative answer.

action.generative_answer.prompt.description: The prompt to use for the generative answer.

action.respond_immediately.description: The agent will immediately respond with a preconfigured response.

action.respond_immediately.responses.description:
The canned responses for the agent to choose from. The response is chosen
randomly.

action.respond_immediately.responses.dis.description:
Whether the response is disabled. Disabled responses are not used by the
agent.

action.respond_immediately.responses.tex.description: Text for the agent to respond with.

action.transfer_agent.description: The agent will transfer the conversation to a different agent.

action.transfer_agent.agent.description:
The name of the agent to transfer the conversation to. The agent must be
in the same app as the current agent.
Format:
'projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/agents/{agent}'

code_callback.description:
Guardrail that blocks the conversation based on the code callbacks
provided.

code_callback.after_agent_callback.description:
A callback defines the custom logic to be executed at various stages of
agent interaction.

code_callback.after_agent_callback.disab.description:
Whether the callback is disabled. Disabled callbacks are ignored by the
agent.

code_callback.after_agent_callback.pytho.description: The python code to execute for the callback.

code_callback.after_model_callback.description:
A callback defines the custom logic to be executed at various stages of
agent interaction.

code_callback.after_model_callback.disab.description:
Whether the callback is disabled. Disabled callbacks are ignored by the
agent.

code_callback.after_model_callback.pytho.description: The python code to execute for the callback.

code_callback.before_agent_callback.description:
A callback defines the custom logic to be executed at various stages of
agent interaction.

code_callback.before_agent_callback.disa.description:
Whether the callback is disabled. Disabled callbacks are ignored by the
agent.

code_callback.before_agent_callback.pyth.description: The python code to execute for the callback.

code_callback.before_model_callback.description:
A callback defines the custom logic to be executed at various stages of
agent interaction.

code_callback.before_model_callback.disa.description:
Whether the callback is disabled. Disabled callbacks are ignored by the
agent.

code_callback.before_model_callback.pyth.description: The python code to execute for the callback.

content_filter.description: Guardrail that bans certain content from being used in the conversation.

content_filter.banned_contents.description: List of banned phrases. Applies to both user inputs and agent responses.

content_filter.banned_contents_in_agent_.description: List of banned phrases. Applies only to agent responses.

content_filter.banned_contents_in_user_i.description: List of banned phrases. Applies only to user inputs.

content_filter.disregard_diacritics.description: If true, diacritics are ignored during matching.

content_filter.match_type.description:
Match type for the content filter.
Possible values:
SIMPLE_STRING_MATCH
WORD_BOUNDARY_STRING_MATCH
REGEXP_MATCH

llm_policy.description:
Guardrail that blocks the conversation if the LLM response is considered
violating the policy based on the LLM classification.

llm_policy.allow_short_utterance.description:
By default, the LLM policy check is bypassed for short utterances.
Enabling this setting applies the policy check to all utterances,
including those that would normally be skipped.

llm_policy.fail_open.description:
If an error occurs during the policy check, fail open and do not trigger
the guardrail.

llm_policy.max_conversation_messages.description:
When checking this policy, consider the last 'n' messages in the
conversation.
When not set a default value of 10 will be used.

llm_policy.policy_scope.description:
Defines when to apply the policy check during the conversation. If set to
'POLICY_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED', the policy will be applied to the user input.
When applying the policy to the agent response, additional latency will
be introduced before the agent can respond.
Possible values:
USER_QUERY
AGENT_RESPONSE
USER_QUERY_AND_AGENT_RESPONSE Possible values: ["USER_QUERY", "AGENT_RESPONSE", "USER_QUERY_AND_AGENT_RESPONSE"]

llm_policy.model_settings.description: Model settings contains various configurations for the LLM model.

llm_policy.model_settings.model.description:
The LLM model that the agent should use.
If not set, the agent will inherit the model from its parent agent.

llm_policy.model_settings.temperature.description:
If set, this temperature will be used for the LLM model. Temperature
controls the randomness of the model's responses. Lower temperatures
produce responses that are more predictable. Higher temperatures produce
responses that are more creative.

llm_prompt_security.description:
Guardrail that blocks the conversation if the input is considered unsafe
based on the LLM classification.

llm_prompt_security.fail_open.description:
Determines the behavior when the guardrail encounters an LLM error.
- If true: the guardrail is bypassed.
- If false (default): the guardrail triggers/blocks.
Note: If a custom policy is provided, this field is ignored in favor of
the policy's 'failOpen' configuration.

llm_prompt_security.custom_policy.description:
Guardrail that blocks the conversation if the LLM response is considered
violating the policy based on the LLM classification.

llm_prompt_security.custom_policy.allow_.description:
By default, the LLM policy check is bypassed for short utterances.
Enabling this setting applies the policy check to all utterances,
including those that would normally be skipped.

llm_prompt_security.custom_policy.fail_o.description:
If an error occurs during the policy check, fail open and do not trigger
the guardrail.

llm_prompt_security.custom_policy.max_co.description:
When checking this policy, consider the last 'n' messages in the
conversation.
When not set a default value of 10 will be used.

llm_prompt_security.custom_policy.policy.description:
Defines when to apply the policy check during the conversation. If set to
'POLICY_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED', the policy will be applied to the user input.
When applying the policy to the agent response, additional latency will
be introduced before the agent can respond.
Possible values:
USER_QUERY
AGENT_RESPONSE
USER_QUERY_AND_AGENT_RESPONSE

llm_prompt_security.custom_policy.model_.description: Model settings contains various configurations for the LLM model.

The LLM model that the agent should use.
If not set, the agent will inherit the model from its parent agent.

If set, this temperature will be used for the LLM model. Temperature
controls the randomness of the model's responses. Lower temperatures
produce responses that are more predictable. Higher temperatures produce
responses that are more creative.

llm_prompt_security.default_settings.description: Configuration for default system security settings.

model_safety.description:
Model safety settings overrides. When this is set, it will override the
default settings and trigger the guardrail if the response is considered
unsafe.

model_safety.safety_settings.category.description:
The harm category.
Possible values:
HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH
HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT
HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT
HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT Possible values: ["HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH", "HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT", "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT", "HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT"]

model_safety.safety_settings.threshold.description:
The harm block threshold.
Possible values:
BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE
BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE
BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH
BLOCK_NONE
OFF Possible values: ["BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE", "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE", "BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH", "BLOCK_NONE", "OFF"]
